description: This file contains service functions for managing classes and class sessions in a gym management system, including creating, updating, deleting, and listing classes and sessions.

methods.name: create_class
methods.description: Creates a new class with specified title, description, and capacity.

methods.name: update_class
methods.description: Updates an existing class identified by class_id with provided fields.

methods.name: delete_class
methods.description: Deletes a class identified by class_id.

methods.name: list_classes
methods.description: Returns a list of all classes.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new class session with specified start and end times, capacity, and initializes spots_remaining.

methods.name: list_sessions
methods.description: Lists class sessions, optionally filtered by class_id, ordered by start_time.
